intent: 3.0 P1.2: retire _fix_gitignore + session-blocks dir creation from enterprise repo_init
notes: **P1.2** — `enterprise/enterprise-cli/gator_enterprise_cli/commands/repo_init.py`: three deletions removing the last actively-harmful vestige of the pre-transcripts-first "commit session-blocks to Git as evidence" design. Every prior `gator-enterprise repo init` (a) created `.gator/session-blocks/` in the repo, (b) called `_fix_gitignore(repo_path)` to un-gitignore it, and (c) had the `_fix_gitignore` function body waiting to strip the ignore rule from any pre-existing `.gitignore`. Under the transcripts-first MVP (2026-08-08), evidence lives in Enterprise-managed storage (DB + blob store), NOT in Git. The old flow directly contradicted the ratified architecture.
Removed the `(gator_dir / "session-blocks").mkdir(exist_ok=True)` in `_do_repo_init` (line ~123). Replacement comment names the retirement date and cross-references the MVP plan §2 D2 OBSOLETE list.

**Consequence**: `.gator/session-blocks/` stays gitignored globally (repo-root `.gitignore` line 46 unchanged); sandbox commits do not accumulate block artifacts under any Enterprise-provisioning path; evaluators inspecting `.gitignore` post-`repo init` see no governance-driven rewrites; the "why is my `.gitignore` being edited?" evaluator-mislead vector from stabilization plan §3.3 Item 3 is closed.

**Not touched**: session-block generation elsewhere in enterprise-cli (`block_generate.py`), server-side session-blocks routes/services (`enterprise/app/services/session_blocks.py`, `enterprise/app/routes/session_blocks.py`, `enterprise/app/models/evidence_block.py`), migration 005/007 SQL, and the `POST_COMMIT_HOOK` template in `activate.py` — that hook's inline block invocation is the P1.3 cleanup, coming in a separate commit. Bulk server-side retirement is post-3.0 (§4 P3.2) since it's inert while unused.

**Charter** — `.gator/charters/scripts-enterprise.md`: added a new `!` tripwire entry describing what `_do_repo_init` explicitly no longer does (session-blocks dir, `_fix_gitignore` call, function body all retired), naming the three source-line removals, the consequence for evaluators, and the post-MVP retirement scope kept out of this commit.
**Test evidence**: `enterprise/tests/test_repo_init.py` = 8 passed (no test pinned `_fix_gitignore` behavior — grep confirmed before deletion). No other enterprise test suite touched.
